# orig from raw, use rows 2..26; panels col ranges 2..5, 8..12? 15..19? 23..26
orig=[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in raw.splitlines()]
from collections import Counter
for name, cols in [('A',range(2,6)),('B',range(8,13)),('C',range(15,20)),('D',range(22,27))]:
  print('\n',name)
  mat=[orig[r][c] for r in range(2,27) for c in cols]
  w=len(list(cols)); mat=[orig[r][cols.start:cols.stop] for r in range(2,27)]
  vals=[]
  for p in range(1,13):
    mismatch=0; details=[]
    for j in range(w):
      for phase in range(p):
        obs=[mat[i][j] for i in range(len(mat)) if i%p==phase]
        cnt=Counter(obs); winner=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        mismatch+=len(obs)-cnt[winner]
    vals.append((mismatch,p))
  print(sorted(vals)[:8])
